summary: Change the DNS credential of a certificate

parameters.name: certID
parameters.description: ID of the certificate that uses the DNS challenge, as the list shows it

requestBody.description: DNS credential to use from the next renewal on

npmpro_dns_credential_id.description: ID of the saved DNS credential to use, as the DNS credential list shows it

200.description: The certificate with the new credential

description:
Links another saved DNS credential to a Let's Encrypt certificate that uses the DNS challenge. It is used from the next renewal on, and it must belong to the same DNS provider as the certificate. Any other certificate answers 400.

Needs: Certificates manage
